name: Fire I
uniques: Can instantly construct a [Smoke] improvement <for all movement>

civilopediaText.text: Fire I, gated by Fire Mana when chosen. Cast Blaze to place Smoke on the caster's Forest/Jungle tile, spending all movement. ExtraModMod spreads fire and consumes forests; this smoke hazard is a simplified native-Unciv effect without spreading or automatic expiration.
Wizard signature ability in FFH2. Additional casting behavior is not yet available in this mod.

name: Body I
uniques: [This Unit] gains the [Hastened] status for [2] turn(s) <for all movement>

civilopediaText.text: Body I, gated by Body Mana. Cast a first native-Unciv Haste prototype: a temporary movement bonus on the caster, spending its movement. The original ExtraModMod spell affects qualifying friendly units nearby; area targeting is not yet implemented.
Mind I. Sphere access is tied to Mind Mana; Charm and other Mind spells are not yet implemented.

Death I, gated by Death Mana. Cast Raise Skeleton: summons a permanent combat-strength-2 Skeleton beside this caster, consuming all movement. The 3-per-civilization living cap is a temporary testing approximation, not ExtraModMod's caster-linked summon cap.
Temporary Haste status from Body I. Its status expires automatically. Unlike ExtraModMod's area Haste, the current action targets the caster only.
